name: Bootstrap 5 (Dracula look)
description: The migration skin: a Bootstrap 5 + Dracula foundation (dracula.css + its reference component set), translated onto the t-* vocabulary. Bootstrap 5.3 metrics (control padding, 6px radius, 1.5 line-height, system font stack) in pure CSS; nothing vendored.
notes: Pure CSS translation of dracula.css + reference/*.css: every --drac-* became its --t-* token, every rgba() tint a color-mix() of the tone. Bootstrap itself is not vendored: that foundation already overrode nearly every Bootstrap default, Bootstrap's class selectors cannot be aliased onto tailor attributes without re-declaring anyway, and its JS is unusable under the no-JS rule. Icons: projects using tailor typically use Bootstrap Icons in .t-icon slots; the skin does not depend on them. Light mode checked with Dracula/Alucard; dark with Dracula and Gruvbox.
